novelty_points.claim: 提出TabNet，在各决策步骤利用序列注意力选择表格特征，并提供可解释的特征归因。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes TabNet, using sequential attention to select tabular features at each decision step and provide interpretable feature attributions.
technical_features: 在每个决策步骤选择用于推理的特征。
使用稀疏特征掩码进行特征选择。
提供特征归因和模型全局行为的解释。
technical_features_en: Selects features to reason from at each decision step.
Uses sparse feature masks for feature selection.
Provides feature attributions and insights into global model behavior.

novelty_points.claim: 通过预测被掩蔽的表格特征对TabNet进行自监督预训练，利用未标注数据改善表格学习。
novelty_points.claim_en: Uses self-supervised pretraining to predict masked tabular features in TabNet, exploiting unlabeled data for tabular learning.
technical_features: 通过预测被掩蔽的特征构造无监督预训练任务。
在未标注数据丰富时使用自监督学习。
technical_features_en: Constructs an unsupervised pretraining task by predicting masked features.
Uses self-supervised learning when unlabeled data is abundant.
